description.en: AI task kanban plugin for DeepSeek Harness — derives task goals, progress and issues from DSH sessions, with session hand-off, subtasks, artifacts and a dual full-page/sidebar UI.
description.zh: 自动从 DSH 会话里提炼任务，生成看板卡片并跟踪进度、阻塞和交付物，一眼看清该管什么。

description.en: Office documents, PDF, presentations, and spreadsheets for DeepSeek Harness
本地优先的私人健康管家：iOS App + 健康内核 + DSH 上的 Agent，监测 → 建议 → 推动执行
description.zh: 本地优先的私人健康管家，盯着你的健康数据，告诉你今天该做什么，还推着你去执行。

description.en: Keeps e-commerce merchant logins in one place: one isolated Chrome or ego lite browser profile per shop for Pinduoduo, Taobao/Tmall, Douyin, JD and 1688, so listing and data-collection scripts reuse a single sign-in; silent and scheduled login checks, automatic credential refill when signed out, scheduled collection jobs driven by a platform-to-metric catalog, and self-update that only deploys verified commits.
description.zh: 把拼多多、淘宝/天猫、抖音、京东、1688 的商家店铺登录态集中管起来：一店一份隔离的 Chrome / ego lite 浏览器档案，上架与采集脚本复用同一份登录态；支持静默与定时检测、掉线自动代填、按「平台→采集域→指标」目录执行定时采集作业，以及只部署经校验 commit 的自更新。

description.en: Telegram mobile remote that attaches the phone to a live DeepSeek Harness Web session: workspace-then-session picker (/sessions), /last for the previous Q/A, /model switch, and native Rich Message replies.
description.zh: Telegram 手机遥控器：附着本机正在跑的 Web 会话，支持 /sessions 工作区→会话选择、/last 查看上次问答、/model 切换模型，以及原生 Rich Message 回复。

description.en: 小说作家智能体预设，用于在DeepSeek Herness里让AI写小说，管理一整套作品工程。
description.zh: 装一次就能让 AI 帮你写小说、编剧、游戏剧本，还能把整部作品的设定和进度都管起来。

description.en: Loads only the basic DSH tools by default and activates the rest on demand, with a per-tool switch list in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 默认只加载基础工具，其余工具按需激活，并在插件设置页以逐工具开关管理。

description.en: Orchestrating local agent skills into deterministic workflows. Built by @JiamingShi-JsPhys, Chelate Shell enforces a 4-layer routing architecture for scientific research.
description.zh: 把二十多个科研技能串成固定流程自动跑，写论文、做计算一条龙不跑偏。

description.en: GitHub authorization, repository browsing, AI-written project intros and confirmed Release publishing inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内完成 GitHub 授权、仓库浏览、AI 生成项目介绍与 Release 发布，所有写操作先预览再确认。

description.en: Configure DSH plugins, MCP servers and skills per client, workspace and session in the desktop and Web UI, with separate settings, inheritance and child defaults.
description.zh: 在桌面和 Web 界面按客户端、工作区和会话分层配置 DSH 插件、MCP 与 Skill，支持独立开关、不同配置、逐级继承及下级默认。

description.en: A BangoCat-style typing feedback widget that auto-snaps to the DSH composer, with customizable art and sound./一个BangoCat风格输入反馈小挂件，可以自动吸附在dsh输入框及窗口边缘，支持自定义形象和音效
description.zh: BangoCat 风格的打字反馈小挂件，自动吸附在 DSH 输入框和窗口边缘，还能自定义形象和音效。

description.en: A VS Code-like workspace panel with a JetBrains-inspired editor: lazy file tree, TypeScript code viewer with syntax highlighting, soft-wrap, find & replace, Quick Open, multi-tab drafts, bracket matching/auto-pair, workspace-wide text search, git status/history with coloured diffs, six VS Code palettes plus follow-DSH, Markdown and image/SVG previews. Nine authenticated host routes serve the filesystem, images, git reads and a quick-open file index.
description.zh: 类 VS Code 的工作区面板，编辑器对照 JetBrains 打磨：懒加载文件树、带语法高亮的 TypeScript 代码视图与软换行、文件内查找替换、Quick Open、多标签草稿、括号匹配/自动配对，全工作区文本搜索、Git 状态/历史与彩色 diff、六套 VS Code 配色并支持跟随 DSH 主题、Markdown 与图片/SVG 预览；Host 端九条鉴权路由提供文件系统、图片、Git 读取与 Quick Open 文件索引。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）娱乐工作台插件，集成音乐播放、小说阅读、漫画浏览、HTML5 小游戏和图片广场，支持阅读书源、洛雪音乐音源、漫画源及 RSS 订阅，提供统一资源管理、本地数据存储与 WebDAV 多设备同步。

Local, offline speech-to-text for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Click the microphone in the composer, speak, and the recognized text is inserted into your draft — transcribed by a RapidSpeech.cpp rs-server running on your own machine. Audio never leaves your computer.
用于DeepseekHarness的主题插件
MOKI Canvas for DSH — a local-first infinite canvas with mind maps, media, and two-way AI collaboration. MOKI 白板 for DSH。

A DSH context-compaction plugin: when the route supports images, it renders the middle of a session history into locally generated 1-bit bitmap frames for the vision model, while the exact head and tail, a bounded exact-token index and a FILES index stay as text.
description.zh: DSH 上下文压缩插件：路由支持图片时，把会话历史的中段在本地渲染成单色位图帧交给视觉模型阅读；精确的首尾文本、有上限的精确 token 索引与 FILES 文件索引仍以文字保留。

description.en: Fork of AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin with its own npm package (@sky_wing_dn/dsh-fairy-zzz): repaints the DSH Web UI as a Wire-Net Terminal host skin, adds an always-on fee dock with balance, today spend and the peak/off-peak countdown, and lets an npm install update itself in one click. Keeps the H.D.D boot animation and voiced greeting, the docked eye badge with usage bubble, and optional local GPT-SoVITS voice; titles use a bundled Anton font instead of a system Impact dependency. Install this fork or the upstream package, not both.
description.zh: AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin 的分支，使用独立 npm 包 @sky_wing_dn/dsh-fairy-zzz：把 DSH Web 界面重绘为 Wire-Net Terminal 宿主皮肤，新增常驻电费坞（余额、今日花费、峰谷倒计时），npm 安装后可一键自更新；保留 H.D.D 开机动画与语音问候、可停靠眼徽与用量气泡、可选本地 GPT-SoVITS 朗读，标题使用随包内置的 Anton 字体，不再依赖系统 Impact。本分支与上游包二选一安装，不要同时装。

description.en: Illustrated desk theme with an adjustable desk lamp (warm, white or rainbow light, beam size), plants, and pets, including a cat that tucks away beside the composer and a sleeping Westie on the new-session screen.
description.zh: 插画风桌面主题：可调节的台灯（暖光、白光、彩虹光，光束大小）、绿植与宠物，含可收进输入框旁的猫和新会话页上睡着的西高地。

description.en: use glm/minimax/openai/claude api in your deepseek harness
DeepSeek Harness 版本的类 CodeX 插件市场

Runtime workarounds for host defects while upstream fixes land: coalesce repeated session/follow rebuilds, reconnect a terminal view whose output stalled, keep the session stream alive when a proxy idles it out, cap job/list subscriptions, recover a session stuck on load, trim the session-list projection on the host and shrink the first-screen history window. Each feature has its own switch; when the host structure does not match, that feature is skipped, logging the reason or degrading silently.
description.zh: 官方修复落地前的宿主缺陷兜底:合并 session/follow 重复重建、终端输出停滞自愈、会话流空闲保活、任务状态流条数上限、会话加载停滞自愈、宿主侧会话列表投影瘦身、首屏历史窗口收敛。每项独立开关,宿主结构不匹配时该项跳过,记录原因或静默降级,不影响页面与其它补丁。

description.en: Hearts of Iron IV modding bundle for DeepSeek Harness: registers 15 skills covering focus trees, events, decisions, ideas, characters, technologies, localisation, GUI and error.log triage, and mounts 20 local MCP tools (a Python stdio server) to scaffold content, statically validate mods, build a SQLite FTS5 knowledge base from the vanilla game, and preview focus trees offline. Ships a 163-document reference library; requires DSH >=0.2.0 <0.3.0 and Python 3.9+ on PATH (standard library only, no game assets).
description.zh: 面向《钢铁雄心4》Mod 开发的 DeepSeek Harness 组合包：注册 15 个技能（国策树、事件、决议、理念、角色、科技、本地化、GUI 与 error.log 分诊），并在本地挂载 20 个 MCP 工具（Python stdio 服务器），用于生成内容、静态校验 Mod、以原版游戏建 SQLite FTS5 知识库、离线预览国策树。附 163 篇参考库；要求 DSH >=0.2.0 <0.3.0 与 PATH 上有 Python 3.9+（仅标准库，不含游戏素材）。

description.en: Session-specific sticky cards with optional, explicitly authorized agent follow-ups. Targets the DSH desktop/web profile (protocol 0.2.2-rc.1); installed from GitHub.
description.zh: 会话专属便签卡片，可选择明确授权智能体按顺序处理便签。面向 DSH 桌面/Web 配置（协议 0.2.2-rc.1），从 GitHub 安装。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH. Each memory is a neuron that lights up, fades, sinks when forgotten, and replays itself when idle.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加长期记忆，每条记忆像神经元会亮会暗，闲时自动回放，说话时把相关记忆递到模型眼前。

description.en: Type /telleru in any conversation and an AI tutor teaches it on a whiteboard in the right sidebar: it clarifies your goal, checks your level with quick questions, has you confirm an outline, then writes structured board content (tables, flowcharts, formulas, code) step by step with optional voice, subtitles, quizzes and interruptible Q&A.
description.zh: 在任意对话里输入 /telleru，AI 老师在右侧白板边写边讲：先问清学习目标、用小题摸底、和你确认大纲，再逐步写出结构化板书（表格、流程图、公式、代码），可选语音讲解与字幕，带快测、检查题，讲解中随时打断提问。

description.en: Host-side continuation for turns that end without declaring completion: a closure rule (present, or a final (TASK_DONE) / (TASK_BLOCKED: reason) line) is injected into the system prompt, and a follow-up user message is sent on silent completion, retryable errors, truncation and restart-interrupted turns, with grace, cooldown and backoff; on cold start it rescans stored sessions and re-arms active goals the host disarmed. Main switches and timing live in the plugin settings card.
description.zh: 回合未声明结案就静默结束时自动补一条用户消息把 AI 拉回:结案规则(present,或末行 (TASK_DONE) / (TASK_BLOCKED: 原因))经文提示词常驻注入,按静默结束、可恢复错误、输出截断、重启中断分类补发,等待/冷却/退避可控;冷启动扫描存储会话恢复未结案回合,并重新武装宿主重启后 disarm 的 active goal。主开关与节奏在插件设置卡片里。

description.en: 知识银河是 DeepSeek Harness 的一个插件。把对话里聊到的知识、读到的论文、日常的研究与方案，随手收录成可筛选、可连线、可在星图里漫游的知识看板。
description.zh: 把聊天里聊到的知识、读过的论文随手收进看板，能筛选、能连线，还能在星图里漫游回顾。

description.en: 卡拉彼丘（Strinova）战绩查询插件：按昵称从 dakanu.com 取数并渲染长图，提供 klbq_query 工具
Search stored DSH conversation text across all or selected workspaces and sessions, with exact, regular-expression, typo-tolerant or word-internal subsequence matching.
更好的Goal实现 | Better goal tool for DSH
description.zh: 替换原生 goal，让目标自动续跑，该停就停、该问就问，操作更省心。

description.en: Tianlight theme/skin for DeepSeek Harness: full-screen video and image wallpapers with upload, rotation, URL and ShaderToy GLSL sources; optional WebWallGL scene wallpapers; liquid glass; and a draggable Mint cat companion with permission-gated AI chat, local chat history and per-look action packs. Alt+W opens the wallpaper panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「天光」主题皮肤：全屏视频/图片壁纸（支持上传、轮播、URL 与 ShaderToy GLSL 代码来源）、可选 WebWallGL 场景壁纸、液态玻璃，以及可拖拽的薄荷猫桌宠（严格权限的 AI 对话、本地对话历史、每个形象的动作包）；Alt+W 打开壁纸面板。

description.en: Expose a DeepSeek Harness agent over the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol: agent card, JSON-RPC, LLM replies.
DSH 实时金价面板插件：侧边栏「黄金实时价格」，卡片展示上金所 Au99.99、国际金价 XAU/USD、工行积存金/如意金、建行积存金的实时报价与交叉校验。
DeepSeek Harness 进度汇报提醒插件：累计每 N 步或每 N 秒提醒 Agent 汇报一次进度，侧栏实时显示计数，聊天区横幅显示上次提醒时刻。附带余额低额提醒与 DeepSeek 峰谷时段指示。
ANP Identity management plugin for DeepSeek Harness

Adds a right-click command "通过 dsh 打开" (open with dsh) to the Windows Explorer right-click menu for a folder, a folder's empty background and any file: it launches DeepSeek Harness on that folder, creates a new session every time, and puts the clicked file into the new draft as an @ reference. Ships a packaged-COM menu for the Windows 11 modern menu plus a registry entry for the classic menu; first install asks once for a certificate trust (native/trust-cert.bat).
description.zh: 给 Windows 资源管理器右键菜单加「通过 dsh 打开」：文件夹、文件夹空白处、任意文件都能用。点击后在对应文件夹启动 DeepSeek Harness 并新建会话；文件右键会把这个文件以 @ 引用预置进新会话草稿。Win11 新式菜单用打包 COM 组件，经典菜单 用注册表项；首次安装需要点一次证书受信（native/trust-cert.bat）。

description.en: Git inside your DSH session: a right-sidebar panel for the current workspace and a global page listing every workspace, one sync button that becomes Fetch, Pull, Push, Publish branch or Sync, a commit tab that opens first with every change checked, AI-written commit messages from the staged diff, plus history, branches, stash and in-panel conflict resolution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话里用 Git：右栏面板管当前工作区仓库，左侧栏全局页列出所有工作区；一个同步按钮按状态变成 Fetch / Pull / Push / Publish branch / Sync；打开面板先看到提交页、改动默认全选；提交信息由 AI 读本次会提交的 diff 生成；另含历史、分支、stash 与面板内冲突解决。

description.en: Composer-side helpers for the DSH Web UI: next-message prediction shown as grey ghost text that Tab fills in, a one-line per-turn recap above the input (placeable below instead) that never enters the model context, a right-sidebar panel for follow-ups from past sessions, recap history and side questions with their own model picker, and config-driven reply length, style and actionable framing.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的一组顺手小件：输入框下方灰字预测下一句、Tab 填入；输入框上方逐轮一行摘要（也可以放到下方）、不进入模型上下文；右侧栏面板管待跟进、会话回顾与旁问，旁问可单独选模型；回复长度、风格与「便于行动」也在插件配置里调。

description.en: Runs a userspace tailscaled for Harness so web fetch, shell, plugin and LLM traffic can each use a Tailscale exit node, leaving routes and DNS untouched. Needs Tailscale's tailscaled installed separately; it starts a second per-user daemon, routes the selected traffic through a loopback proxy and looks up the exit IP through ifconfig.me. An auth key, if you set one, is kept in the plugin config.
description.zh: 为 Harness 单独运行一个用户态 tailscaled：网页抓取、命令行、其他插件、大模型四类流量各自选择是否走 Tailscale 出口节点，系统路由与 DNS 不变。需要另行安装 Tailscale 的 tailscaled；它会再启动一个用户级守护进程，把所选流量经本机回环代理转发，并通过 ifconfig.me 查询出口 IP。若设置了 auth key，会保存在插件配置里。

description.en: The whole 3D toolchain for one machine, in one plugin: printable CAD by natural language through the local SolidCraft CLI (build, edit, measure, preview, inspect, repair), plus thirty Blender skills for organic modelling, materials, lighting, cameras, rendering, UV and animation. Ten agent hosts.
description.zh: 一站式 3D 建模与打印工具链，用自然语言做 CAD，自带 30 个 Blender 技能和打印质量检查。

description.en: Control AI coding agents (DSH / Codex / Claude) from your phone — Feishu long-connection + self-hosted web console. 手机遥控 AI 编码任务：审批、插话、多机切换、E2EE 分享。No inbound ports.
description.zh: 在手机上远程遥控电脑里的 AI 编码任务，随时审批、插话、切换多台机器，不用开公网端口。
边写边预览 Markdown 效果，发送时仍是原始源码，编辑器不受影响。

description.en: AI 创作工作台 for DeepSeek Harness: workspaces + canvas, third-party image APIs and local ComfyUI workflows (image now; editing & video planned).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里搭个 AI 创作工作台，用画布管素材，接第三方生图 API 和本地 ComfyUI 出图。

description.en: DSH plugin: pin a separate LLM route for delegated subagents (Agency experts, Agent Teams members) while the main agent keeps its own model. Settings page included.
description.zh: 给被委派的子代理单独指定 LLM 路由，主 agent 不受影响，避免额度挤在一起卡死。

description.en: Hosts the ai-goofish-monitor scraper for the Xianyu second-hand marketplace: managed backend lifecycle, thirteen goofish_* agent tools, a sidebar panel, and AI listing analysis through the dsh-our-free-model gateway by default.
description.zh: 托管闲鱼二手市场监控后端 ai-goofish-monitor：管理其进程生命周期，提供十三个 goofish_* agent 工具与侧边栏面板，并把商品分析默认接到 dsh-our-free-model 的免费模型网关。

description.en: Native MiniMax for DeepSeek Harness: chat with a subscription (Coding Plan) key or a pay-as-you-go API key, plus image, video, speech and music generation over the official MiniMax API.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接用 MiniMax 官方 API 聊天、画图、做视频、配音和生成音乐，订阅或按量付费都行。

description.en: 让家里大肥鱼不吃白饭，短剧用这一套就够了！（暂未实现，仅供参考/笑）
description.zh: 在 DSH 里搭个短剧工作台，共享画布加会话控制，自动生成短剧素材。

description.en: 奶蛙主题插件 for DeepSeek Harness：赛博启动动画 / 灵感池 / 表情包 / 壁纸整合
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上奶蛙主题：赛博开机动画、灵感池、表情包上传和壁纸整合，界面更有趣。

description.en: 离开电脑时替你看着微信：DSH 插件，UI Automation + 合成点击，自动回复与全程记账
description.zh: 离开电脑也能自动回复微信消息，还会把每条来信都记下来，不用再担心漏回。

description.en: 🐋 鯨魚谷物語：和鯨魚娘一起過日子的像素農場小鎮｜DeepSeek Harness 桌寵插件，也能單機開瀏覽器玩
description.zh: 和鲸鱼娘一起种田钓鱼、经营小镇的像素桌宠，还能跟 AI 聊天、写睡前日记。

description.en: Reversible context folding plus external memory for DeepSeek Harness: tool output collapses into expandable lines, session facts become auditable records.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的可逆上下文折叠 + 外部记忆：工具输出与模型回复折叠成一行可展开的摘要（12 个长会话实测 52×），会话事实沉淀成可像文件一样浏览的带证据记录（rcs:// 寻址、L0/L1/L2 分层、每条事实可回查来源）。

description.en: Clean-room, robots-aware web information gathering toolkit for agents and analysts. Search 360/Bing/Sogou, read Bilibili, Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Weibo and other public sites as Markdown, and browse with resumable sessions. CLI, MCP server and Claude Code skill.
description.zh: 把 360/Bing/搜狗搜索和 B站、知乎、小红书、微博等公开网页抓成干净 Markdown，直接喂给 AI 用。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上「删除会话」：侧栏菜单一键删除，递归清理子会话、日志、投影缓存、搜索索引与工作区记账。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 补上删除会话功能，一键连子会话、日志和缓存一起清干净。

description.en: 把 Cindy 手机客户端接到这台电脑的 DeepSeek Harness：会话、消息、审批、todo/goal、文件（DSH Host 侧插件）

自包含 DSH 陪伴插件：五区可塑人格、七层记忆、上下文压缩、记忆合并、B 站文风学习、陪伴分寸与心声；零额外模型调用，省 token。A self-contained DSH companion plugin: five-region persona, seven-layer memory, compression, memory merge, style learning, token-frugal by design.
DeepSeek Harness计费
DSH 记忆系统（本地优先 · 真·记忆算法）：JSONL + 本地嵌入(bge-m3) + 六工具 + 四层注入 + 语义去重合并/冲突检测 + FSRS 式记忆强度与取用反馈 + 事实有效期 + 周期巩固 + 生命周期（休眠/软删/快照）+ 可视面板。Linux 与 Android/Termux 适配，基于上游 RestRegular/dsh-memory（MIT）持续增强。
用于在dsh中播放自己想听的音乐
Notion for DeepSeek Harness: MCP OAuth connection, 12 Notion skills, multi-workspace settings UI
实现与 WorkBuddy 高度一致的拖拽/粘贴文件引用体验
Your Pinterest saves on the left, a personalized Pinterest feed on the right. Hit ♥ on anything you like and it lands in your collection.
ShotTagGo DSH - full-frame screenshot annotation for DeepSeek Harness
UI design knowledge base: 99 filterable design cards with live demos, implementation prompts and per-design usage notes, plus an agent tool that finds and applies them.
description.zh: UI 设计知识库：99 项可筛选设计，带可交互 demo、实现提示词和适用/不适用场景，配套 agent 工具按场景检索并应用。

description.en: Chinese tax and cross-border e-commerce workbench: a local BigInt statement parser for Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Stripe CSV/TSV/XLSX exports (fintax_parse_statement), a 7-scenario deterministic tax and reconciliation calculator (fintax_calc), 4 read-only Tencent IMA knowledge-base tools (ima_list_kbs, ima_browse, ima_search, ima_read), 4 bundled compliance skills, and an in-app settings section. Statement files are parsed locally; optional IMA credentials are read from environment variables or ~/.config/ima/ (write-only via authenticated /api/fintax routes, never echoed back) and sent only to ima.qq.com; zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 中国财税与跨境电商工作台：提供 Amazon、TikTok Shop、Stripe 原始结算账单本地 BigInt 离线解析与异常雷达工具（fintax_parse_statement）、7 场景确定性算税与四层口径差额桥接工具（fintax_calc）、4 个腾讯 IMA 知识库只读检索工具（ima_list_kbs、ima_browse、ima_search、ima_read）、4 项合规自查技能及内置设置面板。账单文件仅在本地离线解析；可选的 IMA 凭证从环境变量或 ~/.config/ima/ 读取（/api/fintax 路由逐请求经宿主 connection 准入校验，密钥只写不回传明文）并仅发送至官方 ima.qq.com；纯 ESM 零运行时依赖。

description.en: Fork of shaobeichen/dsh-pocket for remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: QR-code access over LAN or a cloudflared tunnel with live sync; mobile layout is left to DSH itself, the plugin adds safe-area and touch chrome, soft-keyboard Enter inserts a newline while hardware keyboards send on Enter, and install/update is left to the plugin manager. The command-line mode listens on 0.0.0.0 by default so a phone on the same Wi-Fi can scan the QR code; it generates an access password (embedded in the QR code) unless you pass --no-auth, and a cloudflared tunnel exposes the Web UI beyond your LAN.
description.zh: shaobeichen/dsh-pocket 的 fork：手机扫码经局域网或 cloudflared 隧道远程访问 DSH Web 界面并实时同屏；移动端布局交还 DSH 官方，插件只补安全区与触控样式，软键盘回车换行、外接键盘回车发送，安装与更新交给插件管理器。命令行模式默认监听 0.0.0.0，好让同一 Wi-Fi 下的手机扫码；除非加 --no-auth，否则会生成访问密码（嵌在二维码里）；cloudflared 隧道会把 Web 界面暴露到局域网之外。

description.en: Runtime monitor for the plugins installed in a DSH profile: the panel lists every bundle and plugin entry with its Cordis fiber state and load diagnostics, scores risk from failed entries, missing bundles, version exemptions, install scripts, bin entries, a missing license and non-registry sources, keeps a timeline of state changes, and can disable a plugin entry or a whole bundle without leaving the panel.
description.zh: 监控 DSH 配置里已安装插件的运行时面板：列出每个 bundle 与插件条目及其 Cordis fiber 状态与加载诊断，依据条目失败、bundle 缺失、版本豁免、安装脚本、bin 入口、缺失许可证与非注册表来源计算风险分，记录状态变化时间线，并可在面板内停用某个插件条目或整个 bundle。

description.en: One switch that routes the git, npm and pip commands DSH runs through a local HTTP proxy, restoring every previous setting when turned off.
description.zh: 一个开关，让 DSH 运行的 git、npm、pip 命令走本机代理，关闭时逐项还原原有设置。

description.en: Skill manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: lists global and project-level skills with call counts, last-used dates and estimated context tokens, and archives or restores a skill by moving its directory into a reversible skill-archive next to the skills root.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏「Skill 管理」：列出全局与项目级 skill 的调用次数、最近使用时间与估算占用 tokens，支持把 skill 目录移入同级可逆的 skill-archive 归档、以及一键还原。

description.en: Calculator tool that evaluates arithmetic expressions with a hand-written recursive-descent parser. No eval or new Function; whitelisted identifiers, length and nesting limits, and structured error codes.
description.zh: 计算器工具：手写递归下降解析器求值算术表达式，不使用 eval 或 new Function，标识符白名单、长度与嵌套上限、结构化错误码。

description.en: A Chinese-thinking plugin built for Chinese users: registers a system prompt section at order -900 so the agent reasons in Simplified Chinese.
description.zh: 适合中国宝宝的中文思考插件：在系统提示词 order -900 注册段落，让 Agent 用简体中文思考。

description.en: Literature reading workbench in the sidebar: import PDFs into a library that groups a paper with its supporting materials, read and annotate in a built-in viewer, and chat over your notes for summaries and insights.
description.zh: 侧栏里的文献阅读工作台：把 PDF 导入文献库，正文与支撑材料归到同一篇下；内置阅读器可阅读批注；还能基于笔记对话做总结与洞察。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness quota dashboard: current-model floating pill, DeepSeek balance and official usage charts, OpenCode Go monthly and per-model quota, and GLM / Xiaomi MiMo balances.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 额度面板：跟随当前会话模型的悬浮胶囊，展示 DeepSeek 余额与官网用量图、OpenCode Go 总额度与分模型额度，以及 GLM / 小米 MiMo 余额。

description.en: Pre-install security gate: quarantines each plugin, skill and subagent bundle with install scripts disabled, scans it with Cisco Skill Scanner, SkillScan, Cisco MCP Scanner, OSV-Scanner, Trivy, Gitleaks and optional SARIF tools or an LLM judge on a DSH model, then passes, asks for review or blocks it. Needs the install-gate hook proposed in deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#12999.
description.zh: 安装前安全闸门：在禁用安装脚本的隔离区中检查每个插件、技能和子代理组合包，使用 Cisco Skill Scanner、SkillScan、Cisco MCP Scanner、OSV-Scanner、Trivy、Gitleaks 以及可选的 SARIF 工具或基于 DSH 模型的 LLM 判定进行扫描，然后放行、要求审查或阻止。需要 deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#12999 中提议的 install-gate 钩子。

description.en: Ordered and unordered list editing in the DSH composer: automatic numbering and renumbering, marker-aware caret moves, level promotion, and an undoable AI prompt-polish button.
description.zh: 输入框有序/无序列表编排：自动续号与重排、标记感知的光标移动、层级升降，以及可撤销的 AI 提示词优化按钮。

description.en: QwenWork (千问办公) model provider for dsh: signs in through the desktop device flow and then calls the official OpenAI-compatible gateway, so tool calls, image input and usage pass through; adds the tiers of the plan as a qwenwork provider, keeps the credential in a local file that a refresh rewrites in place, and shows the remaining credits of the account.
description.zh: 把千问办公（QwenWork）接成 dsh 的模型提供方：用桌面端设备码登录，直连官方 OpenAI 兼容网关，工具调用、图片输入和 usage 都能透传；在 qwenwork 下提供套餐里的各档模型，凭据落在本地文件、到期自动刷新写回，并显示账号剩余积分。

description.en: A wall of photographs hung behind the main panel - uneven sizes at their own angles with room to breathe, twenty real landscape photographs shipped to fill it on first run, up to twenty rotating images per frame, rectangles only, the three lowest frames playing a local video, and one shortcut that sends the video back into the rotation.
description.zh: 挂在主面板背后的一面照片墙：大小不一、各自倾斜、彼此留白。自带二十张真实风景照，首次启动就挂上墙；每个画框最多二十张图轮播，最下面三个框可以放本地视频，一个快捷键让视频退回照片轮播。

description.en: DeepSeek 破甲：dsh-purge 一键安装版（macOS/Linux/Windows）— 让所有模型都能破甲，含红队演练台
description.zh: 一键装好 dsh-purge，让各类模型都能破甲，还自带红队演练台方便做安全评测。

description.en: DGW：GUI Git tool for Deepseek Harness
description.zh: 在对话工作台里可视化管仓库、分支和 PR/MR，还能让 AI 直接提交推送代码。

description.en: Generative UI for DeepSeek Harness: renders Google A2UI 1.0 surfaces inside the conversation with an agent -> UI -> agent interaction loop.
description.zh: 在对话里直接渲染 A2UI 交互界面，让智能体和你通过界面来回互动，操作更直观。

description.en: 把 DSH 会话里的产物（最终回复、Markdown、图片、文件）集中收纳的插件：顶部页签 + 右侧栏标签 + 跨会话索引 + 主题字号 + 导出下载
description.zh: 把会话里的回复、Markdown、图片和文件集中收纳到一个面板，还能跨会话查找、导出下载。
把选题变成按计划自动执行的日报，每期生成一份带时间戳的报告。

description.en: 让 DSH 根据当前情境生成小测试，在确认、纠正和删除中学习协作偏好。
description.zh: DSH 用小测验摸清你的协作偏好，确认后才在后续回答里参考。

description.en: DSH Best Workspace — Codex 风格的 DSH 左侧边栏：项目/会话树、分组、置顶、拖拽排序与输入框 ↑↓ 翻历史
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧栏改成 Codex 风格的项目/会话树，支持分组、置顶、拖拽排序和输入框翻历史。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画插件：片头视频 / suite 模板 / 屏保 / 素材池，带可视化设置卡
description.zh: 把开机动画、片头视频、屏保和素材池整合到一起的启动美化插件，还带可视化设置卡。

description.en: Browser-style session tab bar for the DSH Web UI · 窗口底部的浏览器风格会话标签栏
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 底部加一条浏览器风格的会话标签栏，多个会话并排切换，状态一眼看清。

description.en: DSH 代码工作台插件：代码/Markdown 编辑、文件搜索、Git 差异
description.zh: 在 DSH 文件树旁直接编辑代码和 Markdown，还能查看 Git 改动，轻量又顺手。

description.en: DSH 文案工作台：审核/润色/改写文案、多模型对比、AI 配图，以及通用模型调用（ai_task / ai_models / ai_image）。零运行期依赖，只使用 DSH 已注册模型。
description.zh: 写文案、审稿润色、多模型对比加 AI 配图，一个工作台全搞定，还能直接调用已注册模型。

description.en: Layered temporal memory engine for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套分层记忆，会记工作记忆、经历和事实，还能按时间自然遗忘。

description.en: Cost ledger tab for DSH: per-turn token accounting converted to CNY, stacked daily charts styled after the DeepSeek console, and a built-in Alibaba Bailian price book covering 142 models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax). Models no catalogue covers stay explicitly unpriced instead of being counted as zero, and a manual price fills them in with one click.
description.zh: 「费用」标签页：按天、按模型统计 token 花费并折算成人民币，堆叠柱状图对齐 DeepSeek 官方控制台，悬停即可看到当天每个模型花了多少；内置阿里百炼官方价目表 142 个模型（千问、DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM、MiniMax），缓存命中按官方 10% 规则计价；查不到价的模型明确标为「未定价」并可一键手填，绝不静默算成 0。

description.en: Per-step thinking-effort pilot for DeepSeek Harness: simple tool rounds stay cheap, failures and heavy work lift one declared step, and agents can change their own depth through a set_effort tool without switching models.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逐步思考强度驾驶：简单工具轮保持低档、失败与重活自动升一档，Agent 还能通过 set_effort 工具在不切换模型的情况下调整自身思考深度。

description.en: 给 DSH 工作区添加文件夹
description.zh: 给工作区多挂几个可写文件夹，文件工具和 shell 直接读写，不用反复授权。

description.en: 一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web profile 的 GitHub 工作区插件。  它把 GitHub 仓库绑定到当前 Workspace，在 Harness 内提供 Issues、Pull requests 和 Changes 三个视图；Host 端处理本地 Git、GitHub API 与凭据，Client 端只负责界面和交互。
description.zh: 把 GitHub 仓库绑到 Harness 工作区，直接在界面里看 Issues、PR 和本地改动，顺手完成 Git 操作。

description.en: Ink Whale — a black-and-white DSH theme with pale-blue ASCII whales.
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上黑白墨色主题，还有淡蓝 ASCII 鲸鱼在界面上慢慢游，好看又安静。

description.en: One-click jump to the top of a DeepSeek Harness conversation
description.zh: 一键跳回 DeepSeek Harness 会话顶部，自动加载全部「更早」消息，省得反复点。

description.en: Watches Feishu/Lark Minutes, writes a full meeting note and a title for each recording into Feishu Docs, and keeps one index document that maps minutes to notes.
description.zh: 自动发现飞书妙记，为每条录音生成完整会议纪要与标题并写入飞书文档，并用一篇索引文档维护妙记与纪要的对应关系。

description.en: China Mobile Cloud Drive (139) inside DSH: browse, upload, download and move files, plus 12 model tools. Its /api/dsh-mcloud routes (sign-in, list, download, move, delete) are mounted with webServer.register without DSH Host/Origin admission, so a web page open in your browser can act on the signed-in cloud drive through them.
description.zh: 中国移动云盘（139）接入 DSH：浏览、上传、下载、转移网盘文件，并提供 12 个模型工具。它的 /api/dsh-mcloud 路由（登录、列目录、下载、移动、删除）通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能经由它们操作已登录的云盘。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: view micromamba environments and select one per workspace
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接查看 micromamba 环境，还能给每个工作区单独挑一个用，省得来回切命令行。

description.en: 让 DSH 更贴合 NEVSTOP-LAB 使用习惯的本地化定制插件
description.zh: 按 NEVSTOP-LAB 的使用习惯定制 DSH，功能可逐项开关，关掉就回到原生状态。

description.en: PaoPao: a companion layer for DSH - proactive QQ messages by weighted mood, B? video picking, voice/image/video understanding. Based on dsh-onebot.
description.zh: 给 DSH 接上 QQ 通道，还能按心情权重主动找你聊天、发 B 站视频，并看懂语音、图片和视频。

description.en: DSH Web plugin: DeepSeek Platform wallet balances in USD/CNY, CBR RUB conversion, session and day spend
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里直接查看 DeepSeek 钱包余额，支持美元、人民币和卢布换算，还能看会话和当天花了多少。

description.en: 微信会话互通聚合包：桌面弹窗 / 系统通知 + 提示音，30/60 秒超时后经 dsh-im 微信机器人把带问题原文与编号选项的清单发到微信，可直接在微信里回复选择。
description.zh: 需要你确认或选择时弹窗提醒，超时自动把问题发到微信，直接微信回复就能选。

description.en: DSH plugin: save public X (Twitter) posts as offline Markdown with a three-pane library reader. 把公开 X 链接保存为可离线阅读的 Markdown。
description.zh: 把公开 X 帖子链接存成离线 Markdown，按收藏夹和博主归类，三栏阅读器随时翻看。

description.en: After you approve a plan review, automatically close every plan tab of that session in the right sidebar, including tabs left by earlier revision rounds.
description.zh: 点「同意执行」批准计划、计划模式退出后，自动关闭该会话右侧边栏里的全部计划标签页，含多轮修订留下的多个。

description.en: A DSH agent preset that turns one session into a small, coordinated research team.
description.zh: 一个会话就能拉起一支小研究团队，分工协作帮你查资料、做调研。

description.en: 给 DSH 会话列表加一个能真删除的按钮：让宿主 registry 遗忘、清掉正文与投影缓存。零依赖小插件，附说明与免责声明。
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话列表加个真删除按钮，一键清掉会话记录和缓存，不是归档。

description.en: Skill panel for the DSH web GUI: built-in, local and market-installed skills in one list, each with an on/off switch.
description.zh: 把内置、本地和已安装的技能汇总到一个面板里，每项带开关，随时启用或停用。

description.en: Telegram look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — a solid-colour wallpaper with a tinted doodle pattern, a floating chat-list card, session rows with avatars and times, message bubbles with read ticks, a floating composer, and three palettes (Classic, Glass, Pink).
description.zh: 为 DSH 换上 Telegram 的主题——纯色底加染色涂鸦图案的墙纸、浮动的会话列表卡片、带头像和时间的会话行、消息气泡、悬浮输入条，以及经典、玻璃、粉色三套配色

description.en: One panel for the plugins and skills a DSH installation runs: per-row switches, groups, presets, rule-based auto grouping.
description.zh: 一个面板统一管理 DSH 实际运行的插件、技能和 MCP 服务，逐项开关、分组和预设，还能按规则自动归类。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for Tripo, Meshy, Hyper3D, qianwenai/DashScope and Tencent Hunyuan3D async 3D generation, with in-chat 3D preview. | 让 DSH 在设置→3D 生成中接入 Tripo、Meshy、Hyper3D、qianwenai 和腾讯混元3D，并在对话内直接预览 3D 模型。
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里填好密钥，就能调用 Tripo、Meshy、混元3D 等平台异步生成 3D 模型，还能在对话里直接预览。

description.en: 手动筛选并移除 DSH 会话中的低价值问答或单条消息：在回复旁原位选中、✓ 确认、内容随即从对话中消失，可撤销；液态玻璃面板。
description.zh: 不用新开会话，勾选就能把对话里没用的问答或单条消息筛掉，还能撤销。

description.en: DSH plugin: nested subagent sessions in the sidebar, direct child creation, query_session, and turn-cadence prompt nudges
description.zh: 在侧边栏管理父子会话，直接创建子代理，还能按轮次自动提醒，让多智能体协作更顺手。

description.en: DSH 的工作记忆插件。上下文一压缩、一换窗口，前面聊过的东西就没了；这个插件负责把「丢了就再也找不回来」的那部分留在盘上，并在下一轮重新摆到模型眼前。
description.zh: 把上下文压缩后容易丢的工作记忆存到本地，下一轮再摆回模型眼前，任务进度不丢。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 微信 Agent：统一助手、人物卡与记忆、DSH 工作任务、定时提醒、图片表情与朋友圈自动化。Windows x64。
description.zh: 把 DSH 助手接进微信，能自然聊天、记住授权的人、执行工作任务，还能定时提醒和自动发朋友圈。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek 网页端对话接进 DSH 侧边栏：可折叠的工作区/对话区、Work–Chat 新会话开关、深度思考与联网搜索、Markdown/LaTeX 渲染。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 网页对话搬进 DSH 侧边栏，工作区和对话区可折叠，支持深度思考、联网搜索和 Markdown/LaTeX 渲染。

description.en: 研报级图表 Agent Skill：两套主题、七个 matplotlib 画法、放图时机与标题写法。Claude Code 插件 + DeepSeek Harness 插件。
description.zh: 让智能体用 matplotlib 画出研报级图表，两套主题、多种画法，一眼读出结论。

description.en: Native Windows notifications when an unawaited background job settles (completed, failed, or stopped), when a conversation turn ends, or when the agent waits for a question answer or tool approval.
description.zh: 无人等待的后台任务结算（完成、失败或停止）、对话轮次结束、或 agent 等待你回答问题/工具审批时，弹出 Windows 原生通知。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud in DeepSeek Harness while they stream, sentence by sentence, with a sidebar player that follows the speech line by line.
description.zh: 让 DSH 边生成边把回复念出来，不用等整段写完，也不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.
description.zh: Git 插件 —— 会话 Tab 栏添加 Git 管理功能，支持 commit | pull | push | branch | diff 等基础功能。

description.en: Real-time war room dashboard for a DS Bot team — live activity, message flow, task hand-off and per-Bot token usage (dsh plugin)
Arknights lore memory for DeepSeek Harness: faction files, alias routing, in-world timeline, full story archive, PRTS live lookup and dynamic updates.
面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Bark 推送：直接推送回复正文，以及授权与提问提醒，支持按工作区与按会话静音。
DeepSeek Harness 插件：乐高 Art 马赛克像素画生成器（面板内本地计算不上传、AI 风格优化、PDF 说明书、跨作品颗粒采购清单）
ChatGPT Pass: ChatGPT subscription models and account settings for DeepSeek Harness
Connector Hub for DeepSeek Harness：MCP 连接管理、凭据健康探测与一键修复
在对话里写一段 JSON，就长出一页能点的界面；看完能导成 HTML 带走。Turns a JSON block in the chat into a clickable page you can export as standalone HTML.
DSH 里的 Gemini 出图出片工作室：多账号轮换、原生语音、转场、字幕、成片核验
Deepseek harness im gateway
让 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 对话正文直接显示本地图片的插件：本地路径自动内联为图片 + 可点击的本地地址行
DeepSeek Harness plugin: use your own local OpenCode CLI's models (all your OpenCode providers) inside DSH, the way T3 Code does
DSH plugin: show the Portara gateway's load-balancing route for each reply in the chat stream.
DeepSeek Harness 破甲：提示词注入 + 引擎层补丁，适配 dsh 0.2.2-rc.2。上游 MIT 原作 by @YuJunZhiXue
Separate read-only chat thread in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar
Frosted-glass sidebar skin + activity pill + token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness
Native Sign in with ChatGPT provider for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis). OAuth, live model discovery, Responses streaming, reasoning replay and cache affinity. English / 简体中文.
在同一个 DSH 客户端管理多个 dsh-superagent 项目：一键建仓、克隆、注册工作区、启动实例，并在标签页面板内代理运行。自用测试版，实际使用中可能有意料之外的 bug 和报错。

Verified fork of Superpowers (obra/superpowers) for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — 15 skills for TDD, planning, debugging, and subagent-driven development, with a 64-test suite and a non-destructive, reversible install
Give DeepSeek Harness eyes for video: samples frames with ffmpeg, reads subtitle tracks and container metadata, answers questions about moments. Install: dsh plugin add dsh-video-vision
爆款视频复刻工作台 · DSH 插件：原片 → 角色图（审核门）→ 换人 → 质检 → 成片，支持接入任意 RunningHub 工作流
dsh 插件：在 DSH Web 的会话视图与右侧栏嵌入真实 VS Code（code-server）工作区，切 tab 不重载，未安装时给出安装引导。
Relationship analytics plugin for DeepSeek Harness: person cards, decision timeline, health scores, persona extraction and AI decision advice. Ships with synthetic demo data only.
DSH plugin: a work desk for calendar, email and markets
OPC-玄机 · 一人公司中枢 — 运行在 DSH 上的一人公司中枢插件（中枢调度 + 员工矩阵 + 三级沉淀 + TS 流程固化）
研报撰写工作台（DSH 插件）：研报拆解、PDF 圈选问答、五板块卡片、图表库与报告撰写
Agent skill for original STCA polymer screening, rule extraction and rule-guided candidate design.
adobe/.xd files trans to html/.html files mcp
Session management for DeepSeek Harness — an archived-chat list in Settings, permanent deletion from the session menu, and agent tools to list, inspect, create and fork sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话管家：设置里给已归档会话一个列表，会话菜单里给一个真正的删除，并提供列出、查看、新建、分叉会话的模型工具。

description.en: Download queue with aria2 and optional Xunlei engines, magnet links, and a per-session history; aria2 is not bundled and must be installed separately, and the Xunlei engine needs its own SDK and API key. Built mainly for Windows. Its POST routes (add, pause, remove downloads, with a caller-chosen target directory) are mounted with webServer.register and only check that the connection is from loopback, so a web page open in your browser can queue downloads on your behalf.
description.zh: 下载队列：aria2 与可选迅雷双引擎、磁力链接、按会话记录下载历史；aria2 不随包附带，需自行安装，迅雷引擎需自装 SDK 并提供 API Key；主要面向 Windows。它的 POST 路由（添加、暂停、删除下载，可指定保存目录）通过 webServer.register 挂载，只检查连接来自本机回环，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能替你加下载任务。

description.en: Home Assistant control for DSH: entity states, history, service calls, notifications, weather, and a live home dashboard card.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里控制 Home Assistant：实体状态、历史、服务调用、通知、天气与实时家庭仪表盘卡片。

description.en: One credential store for many API platforms: keeps keys for GitHub, Cloudflare, Vercel, npm, Docker Hub, Hugging Face and custom platforms in the DSH credential store rather than in configuration or the session log, and gives the model three tools. apikey_call takes a path rather than a URL, so a key only reaches the host its platform fixes; apikey_platforms lists platforms and accounts without values; apikey_key gets, sets or clears one. Supports five auth shapes (bearer, custom header, x-api-key, basic, query string), verifies a key against the identity the platform returns, and reports transport failures as readable results instead of ending the turn. By default (exposeKeys on) the apikey_key tool can return a stored key's value to the model, which puts it in the session log; turn exposeKeys off to keep keys inside the Host.
description.zh: 统一管理多个平台 API Key 的凭据库：把 GitHub、Cloudflare、Vercel、npm、Docker Hub、Hugging Face 与自定义平台的 Key 存进 DSH 凭据库（而非配置文件或会话日志），并向模型提供三个工具。apikey_call 的参数是路径而非 URL，Key 只可能发往该平台固定的主机；apikey_platforms 列出平台与账号但不返回值；apikey_key 读取、写入或清除单个 Key。支持五种认证方式（Bearer、自定义头、x-api-key、Basic、查询串），会用平台返回的身份校验 Key，网络故障返回可读结果而不是中断对话。默认（exposeKeys 开启）时 apikey_key 工具可以把已存的密钥值返回给模型，从而进入会话日志；把 exposeKeys 关掉才能让密钥只留在宿主内。

description.en: Before you say yes to an agent, ask how the code works: answers come with an interactive UML diagram (8 types) linked to the text, so pointing at a paragraph highlights it in the diagram and clicking a step jumps to its paragraph. Code quotes are checked against the files.
description.zh: 点 yes 之前先问清代码怎么运作：回答带一张和文字联动的交互式 UML 图（8 种），指向段落图上跟着高亮，点图里的一步文字跳到对应段落；代码引文回到文件里核对。

description.en: Shows a Kobe iced-tea side popup and reports per-turn costs or token counts with bundled offline audio. Uses dsh-cost-meter first, or estimates each request from native usage and public prices. Includes twenty cost phrases, four token phrases, CNY/USD, three-decimal rounding and custom previews; no runtime TTS service or API key. The bundled voice clips are pre-synthesized offline and the portrait is a fan-made image; the package declares UNLICENSED. When it has to estimate a cost itself it fetches a public price table from raw.githubusercontent.com (Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter) and the USD/CNY rate from open.er-api.com, at most once a day, and sends no session data.
description.zh: 每轮结束弹出科比冰红茶人物，离线播报本轮费用或 Token 用量；费用优先使用 dsh-cost-meter，不可用时按各请求原生用量与公开单价估算并标明来源。含二十句金额台词、四句 Token 台词，支持人民币/美元、三位小数四舍五入及自定义试听；无需在线语音服务或 API Key。内置的语音片段是预先合成的离线音频，人物图是网络二创图；包的许可证声明为 UNLICENSED。需要自己估算费用时，它最多每天一次从 raw.githubusercontent.com（Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter）取公开价格表、从 open.er-api.com 取美元兑人民币汇率，不发送会话数据。

description.en: Desktop notifications when a DeepSeek Harness session finishes a turn or needs your approval.
description.zh: 会话完成一轮任务或需要你审批时，弹出系统桌面通知。

description.en: Session-level root privilege bridge for DeepSeek Harness: ask mode with per-request web approval, full root mode (polkit password entry in the web UI) and fakeroot mode, with sudo or run0 --empower escalation and a configurable subagent sudo policy. It escalates real commands with sudo or run0: in ask mode each request waits for your approval; in full root mode every bash command of the session runs elevated after one password entry in the web UI. Delegated subagents need per-request approval by default (subagentPolicy: request).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话级 root 权限桥：申请制（逐次网页审批）、完整 root（网页内 polkit 密码输入）与 fakeroot 三种模式，支持 sudo 或 run0 --empower 提权，子代理 sudo 策略可配置。它用 sudo 或 run0 提升真实命令的权限：申请制下每次请求都等你批准；完全 root 模式下，在网页里输一次密码后整个会话的每条 bash 命令都以提权方式运行。委托的子代理默认逐次审批（subagentPolicy: request）。

description.en: Registers 25 software engineering workflow skills covering spec, planning, build, test, review and ship. Mirrored from addyosmani/agent-skills (MIT).
description.zh: 注册 25 个软件工程工作流技能，覆盖规格、规划、构建、测试、评审与发布。镜像自 addyosmani/agent-skills（MIT）。

description.en: Disk, CPU/memory/GPU, listening-port and token-usage cards with a full-page zoom; runs as a workbench module or standalone. The port card works on Windows only and the GPU card needs nvidia-smi.
description.zh: 磁盘、CPU/内存/GPU、监听端口与会话用量四张卡片，可放大到整页；既可作工作台模块，也能独立运行。端口卡片仅支持 Windows，GPU 卡片需要 nvidia-smi。

description.en: Shell-style Up/Down arrow key message history navigation for DSH Web UI with cross-session persistence and draft restoration. It keeps up to 100 of your past messages as plain text in ~/.dsh/message-history.json, filling it at startup from the session records already under ~/.dsh/sessions, and makes no network requests.
description.zh: 类似于 Shell 的上下方向键历史消息导航，支持草稿暂存恢复与跨会话历史持久化。它把你发过的最近 100 条消息以明文存在 ~/.dsh/message-history.json，启动时从 ~/.dsh/sessions 下已有的会话记录补全，不发任何网络请求。

description.en: Guides RTL design and verification in DeepSeek Harness, with project scaffolding, evidence checks, and OpenROAD/ORFS setup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 RTL 设计与验证指导、工程脚手架、证据核对和 OpenROAD/ORFS 环境准备。

description.en: Permanently deletes one session from its sidebar context menu after a confirmation dialog: the log directory under the DSH home, the projection-cache thumbnail, its id in every workspace.json, and its archived and pinned entries. Sessions resumed since launch are detached from both the sessions and the agents stores first, so the deleted row does not return to the sidebar as an orphan. Refuses while the session is running a turn, and never touches the workspace folder itself.
description.zh: 在会话右键菜单里永久删除一个会话（先弹确认框）：DSH home 下的日志目录、投影缓存缩略图、每个 workspace.json 里的会话 id、以及归档与置顶列表里的条目。本次启动后 resume 进内存的会话会先从 sessions 与 agents 两个 store 里摘除，删掉的会话不会以幽灵条目的形式回到侧边栏。会话正在跑一轮对话时拒绝删除；工作区目录本身不受影响。

description.en: Long-form fiction workflow for DSH: seven queryable bibles, edit-impact tracking, living relationship and plot maps, and a first-chapter tryout that picks your writer. Its /novel-panel routes, including save, archive and reconcile, are mounted with webServer.register and carry no DSH Host/Origin admission check, so a web page open in your browser can write to the novel project through them.
description.zh: 长篇小说创作工作流：七份可查账的设定库、改稿影响追踪、活的图谱，以及用试笔稿选写手的机制。它的 /novel-panel 路由（含保存、归档、对账）通过 webServer.register 挂载，没有 DSH 的 Host/Origin 准入检查，所以浏览器里打开的任意网页都能经由它们写入小说项目。

description.en: Cross-domain search and A-share data for DSH: arXiv, Crossref, GitHub, Hacker News, Hugging Face, Product Hunt, plus stock quotes, klines and announcements.
description.zh: DSH 的跨领域信息与 A 股工具：arXiv、Crossref、GitHub、Hacker News、Hugging Face、Product Hunt，以及行情、走势与公告。

description.en: Collects the failures recorded in DSH session logs — tool failures, turn failures and model retries — folds them into one table merged across sessions and sorted by frequency, showing category, source, error code, count, last-seen time and a summary per row. Each row can start a new session draft pre-filled for root-cause analysis or for prevention (sending still needs your confirmation), and ignoring a row only hides it in the panel without deleting logs.
description.zh: 把会话日志里的工具失败、回合失败与模型重试折叠成一张表，跨会话合并后按出现频次排序，每行显示类别 / 来源 / 错误码 / 出现次数 / 最近时间 / 摘要；每条错误可一键在新会话草稿框里预填「分析」或「防范」提示词（发送仍需用户确认），「忽略」只影响本面板显示、不删日志。

description.en: Generates DSH host-side plugin skeletons — tool registration, an approval hook, a dsh.bundle manifest and three test layers — and registers a plugin_kit_new tool so the agent can scaffold a plugin from inside DSH without a shell.
description.zh: 一条命令生成 DSH host 侧插件骨架（工具注册 + 审批钩子 + dsh.bundle 清单 + 三层测试），并注册 plugin_kit_new 工具，让 agent 不开 shell 也能在 DSH 里搭骨架。

description.en: Writes engineering decisions down the way DSH documents its own — every non-trivial change leaves a Markdown note under .agents/notes/<lifecycle>/<class>/ holding the problem, the decision, the rejected alternatives and the consequences, committed to git and reviewable like code. It supplies the workflow for that: five tools (note_search, note_read, note_write, note_verify, note_skip), an end-of-turn hook that asks a code-changing turn to either write a note or record an explicit skip, the tree/format/archived checks, and the write-notes-like-deepseek skill bundled in the package and mounted by the plugin. A sidebar board that renders the notes into four views (architecture baseline, timeline, rejected proposals, decision list) comes with it; the notes themselves stay plain Markdown.
description.zh: 像 DSH 记录自己的决定那样记录工程决策：每次非平凡改动在 .agents/notes/<lifecycle>/<class>/ 下留一篇 Markdown，写清问题、决定、被否决的备选与后果，进 git、可以像代码一样 review。插件提供这套流程：note_search、note_read、note_write、note_verify、note_skip 五个工具，回合末钩子（改过代码的轮次要写笔记或记录一次显式跳过），树、格式、归档三项校验，以及随包分发、由插件挂载的 write-notes-like-deepseek 技能。另附把这些笔记渲染成四个视图（架构基线、演进时间线、避坑智库、决策清单）的侧边栏看板；笔记本体仍是普通 Markdown。

description.en: Three custom agent presets, one editable character card each, with three built-in personas out of the box; import SillyTavern character-card PNGs or md/txt/json setting files, and the settings section handles naming, editing, and card-image display — edits apply on the next turn with no restart.
description.zh: 三个自定义 agent 预设，每槽一张可编辑角色卡——开箱自带鲸鱼娘/病娇/小满三张预制人设，支持导入 SillyTavern 生态角色卡 PNG 或 md/txt/json 设定文档；设置页「角色卡」区块可取名、编辑、展示卡面图，保存后下一回合生效，无需重启。

description.en: Left sidebar disk panel for the DSH Web UI: volume free space, per-Workspace folder sizes, moving build artifacts to the macOS Trash with an audit log and restore, sending scan results to an agent, and a host-side low-space watchdog with OS notifications. macOS and Linux only; Trash cleanup works on macOS only, while Linux gets the scan, trend and watchdog without cleanup. Cleanup is limited to a fixed list of build-artifact folder names directly under a registered Workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 左侧栏磁盘面板：各卷剩余空间、按工作区统计目录占用、把构建产物安全移入 macOS 废纸篓（带审计与恢复）、把扫描结果交给 Agent 分析，以及 Host 端低空间看门狗与系统通知。仅限 macOS 和 Linux；移入废纸篓只在 macOS 上可用，Linux 上有扫描、趋势和看门狗但没有清理。清理只限注册工作区根目录下一批固定名字的构建产物目录。

description.en: Polishes the composer draft: opening the panel optimizes once with the default template, replacing the draft shows a line-by-line diff first, and a 9-second undo sits on the entry pill. Five templates (basics, structure, examples, reasoning, iteration) switch without spending a call; history and version chains stay on this machine, and the UI follows the Harness language.
description.zh: 输入框旁的提示词优化器：打开面板即按默认模板优化一次，替换草稿前先给逐行 diff，替换后 9 秒内可撤销。五种模板（基础 / 结构 / 示范 / 推理 / 迭代）换选择不计费，历史与版本链存在本机，界面跟随 Harness 语言切换。

description.en: Shows a Windows toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness run finishes, a tool approval is requested, or a question is waiting for an answer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务跑完、需要批准工具调用或等你回答问题的时候，弹出 Windows 系统通知。

description.en: Adds a Restart item to the DeepSeek Harness desktop tray menu, patching the app's tray template in place and re-applying the patch after desktop updates.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端托盘右键菜单加一条「重启 DeepSeek Harness」，原地给应用打补丁，桌面端升级后自动补回。

description.en: Removes the DeepSeek Harness logo, brand name, version string, and the conversation hero fish from the sidebar.
description.zh: Removes the DeepSeek Harness logo, brand name, version string, and the conversation hero fish from the sidebar.

description.en: Recolours and re-lays-out the DSH Web GUI as Tencent WorkBuddy desktop does: mint brand #00c29a, gray sidebar, 24px composer with a single hairline border, 848px column. Values are read from WorkBuddy v5.0.2 asar tokens, not eyeballed; light mode only, pure CSS, restores by removal.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 改成腾讯 WorkBuddy 桌面的样子：薄荷绿品牌色 #00c29a、灰阶侧栏、24px 圆角输入框配单层细描边、对话栏 848px。取值逐项取自 WorkBuddy v5.0.2 安装包里的设计令牌，不是照着照片调；只做浅色，纯 CSS，移除注入的样式即还原。

description.en: Sidebar badge showing the current DeepSeek peak/off-peak billing phase, the countdown to the next switch, the account balance and a 7-day CNY spend chart — with a voice alarm when off-peak starts.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示当前峰谷计费档位、切换倒计时、账户余额和近 7 天人民币花费柱状图；谷时开始时用语音提醒你开工。

description.en: Blurs every image in the conversation body until you click the Show button in its corner, leaving side panels, plugin pages and icons untouched.
description.zh: 对话正文里的图片默认模糊，点图片右上角的「显示」才看清；侧栏、面板与图标不受影响。

description.en: Adds one system-prompt section that limits delegation to subagents and teammates to two cases: adversarial review of freshly produced output, and one-shot context reading that returns a summary.
description.zh: 添加一段系统提示词，把对子智能体和队友的委派限制在两种情况：对刚写出的产出做对抗性审查，以及只回传摘要的一次性大量阅读。

description.en: Shows the balance or quota behind the current conversation's model for DeepSeek, Kimi Code and OpenAI, plus local usage and priced estimates for every provider configured in DSH.
description.zh: 按当前会话模型显示 DeepSeek、Kimi Code 与 OpenAI 的余额或配额，并为 DSH 中配置的每个提供商提供本地用量与价格估算。

description.en: NanoGPT PRO subscription models for DeepSeek Harness: a curated model picker with ×1/×2 rate badges, reasoning levels and the remaining weekly quota, without spending the subscription allowance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 NanoGPT PRO 订阅模型：精选的模型选择器，带 ×1/×2 倍率标记、推理档位和本周剩余额度，且不消耗订阅额度。

description.en: Translates Chinese text rendered by other DSH plugins into English as it appears - plugin cards, settings pages, dropdown menus, plugin view tabs and same-origin iframe panels - while leaving the chat transcript, tool output and anything you type untouched. Uses the shipped translator service (Bing or Google, no key needed) and falls back to the default model.
description.zh: 把其他 DSH 插件显示的中文实时翻译成英文——插件卡片、设置页、下拉菜单、插件视图标签与同源 iframe 面板，同时不改动对话记录、工具输出和你输入的内容。使用内置翻译服务（Bing 或 Google，无需密钥），不可用时回退到默认模型。

description.en: Codex quota card at the sidebar foot, styled like the Command Code panel, plus a quota dashboard: a ring, one row per quota window with reset time and remaining percentage, and a dashboard with credits, spend-limit and reset-credit tiles. Reads the ChatGPT quota that dsh-codex-subscription reports over its bridge.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的 Codex 额度卡片（样式与 Command Code 面板一致），并附带额度仪表盘：环形进度、每个额度窗口一行（含重置时间与剩余百分比），仪表盘展示点数、消费上限与重置次数。数据来自 dsh-codex-subscription 通过其桥接上报的 ChatGPT 额度。

description.en: Douyin for DSH: bounded autonomous watching with storyboard frames and danmaku sampling, persona and interest memory, a daily watch report, plus direct-message auto-reply and one daily greeting for a whitelisted set of friends. This is a maintained fork of dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent 1.4.7 that fixes follow-list read timeouts, unclickable conversations, missed replies, and greetings that stopped scheduling after a single send. Windows only (a dedicated Edge window, Node.js 22.13+). Replies and greetings are sent as ordinary messages with no “automated reply” label, and once you have enabled them they restart by themselves each time DSH launches until you stop them by hand. It registers the same bundle id as dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent and LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent, so it replaces them rather than running next to them.
description.zh: DSH 里的抖音：限时自主观看（抽帧故事板 + 弹幕采样）、人格与兴趣记忆、观看日报，并给许可名单里的好友自动回私信、每天问候一次。本条目是基于 dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent 1.4.7 的维护分支，修掉了关注名单读取超时、会话点不开、漏回消息、问候发一条就停等问题。仅限 Windows（专用 Edge 窗口、Node.js 22.13+）。回复和问候以普通消息发出，不带“自动回复”标记；启用后每次 DSH 启动都会自动恢复，直到你手动停止。它和 dafeiyu1314520/dsh-douyin-agent、LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent 注册同一个 bundle id，是替代而不是并装。

description.en: Confluence and Jira over Atlassian remote MCP as a configuration-only bundle: one MCP client row, OAuth handled by mcp-remote with the token cached in ~/.mcp-auth, no login command and no in-app UI. Exposes mcp__atlassian__* tools (CQL search, pages, comments, JQL issues, transitions).
description.zh: 以纯配置包的形式接入 Atlassian 远程 MCP，提供 Confluence 与 Jira：只加一行 MCP 客户端配置，OAuth 交给 mcp-remote、令牌缓存在 ~/.mcp-auth，没有登录命令也没有界面。工具名为 mcp__atlassian__*（CQL 搜索、页面、评论、JQL 问题、状态流转）。

description.en: Replaces native DSH file-tree file and folder icons with locally bundled vscode-icons artwork and filename associations, preserving native tree interactions and expanded folder states.
description.zh: 使用本地打包的 vscode-icons 图标和文件名映射替换 DSH 原生文件树的文件与文件夹图标，保留原生交互及文件夹展开状态。

description.en: Agent browser for DeepSeek Harness built on playwright-core with two visibility modes, where hidden sessions for private research close themselves after 45 seconds of idling and visible sessions open in a real Edge or Chrome window on request, exposing eight browser_* tools (search, open, read, click, type, screenshot, close, status) and a left-sidebar panel with engine state, live sessions and an activity feed.
description.zh: 基于 playwright-core 的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体浏览器，两种可见性模式：隐藏会话用于私下检索并在闲置 45 秒后自动关闭，可见会话按需在真实的 Edge 或 Chrome 窗口中打开；提供八个 browser_* 工具（search、open、read、click、type、screenshot、close、status），左侧栏面板显示引擎状态、活动会话与操作流水。

description.en: Port of MiMo Code's infinite-context memory: as the window fills it asks the model in the background (the current provider route unless writerProvider/writerModel is set) to write a structured checkpoint and a project MEMORY.md, then, ahead of DSH's native compaction, replaces the visible window with a rebuilt dump of tasks, checkpoint, recent user messages, memory and notes, falling back to a MiMo-style compaction. Memory files live under $DSH_HOME/mimo-context (per session, per project, plus a read-only global one); it adds mimo_* memory, history, checkpoint and rebuild tools and /mimo-* commands, with dream/distill off by default. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or a later 0.2.x.
description.zh: 移植自 MiMo Code 的无限上下文记忆：窗口逐渐填满时，在后台让模型（默认沿用当前模型路由，可用 writerProvider/writerModel 指定）写出结构化 checkpoint 和项目 MEMORY.md，并在 DSH 原生 compaction 之前，用任务、checkpoint、最近用户消息、记忆与笔记重建的内容替换当前可见窗口，没有可用 checkpoint 时回退到 MiMo 式压缩。记忆文件存在 $DSH_HOME/mimo-context（按会话、按项目，另有只读的全局记忆）；提供 mimo_* 记忆、历史、checkpoint、重建工具和 /mimo-* 命令，dream/distill 默认关闭。需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 或之后的 0.2.x。

description.en: Adds up to 3 clickable next-action chips under a reply; clicking one fills the input draft and never sends.
description.zh: 在回复下方给出至多 3 条可点击的下一步建议；点击只填入输入框，不会自动发送。

description.en: Mounts REA's reverse-engineering MCP toolset in DeepSeek Harness behind a composer chip; it is on by default once installed, and switching it off withdraws the tools and stops the MCP child process so idle sessions pay no context for them.
description.zh: 把 REA 的逆向工程 MCP 工具集接进 DeepSeek Harness，输入框工具条上一个开关，装好即默认开启；关掉后工具全部撤走、MCP 子进程退出，不需要它的会话就不花这份上下文。

description.en: A life-care layer for DSH: health log and cycle care in every session, saved coordinates so nearby-place questions do not need re-asking, Amap and Luckin MCP tools, plus a QQ companion layer that injects expression rules into replies.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一层生活关怀：每个会话都带健康日志与周期关怀，面板里存过的常用坐标省掉「你在哪」的反问，高德与瑞幸的 MCP 工具挂进所有会话；另附 QQ 伴生层，把表达规则注入回复。

description.en: Browse and search Tencent ima knowledge bases, read files in an in-panel dock, and add links, files and notes via the ima OpenAPI.
description.zh: 在 Harness 面板中浏览与检索腾讯 ima 知识库，在内置分栏阅读文件，并通过 ima 开放接口添加网页链接、文件与笔记。

description.en: Drops text blocks that carry nothing but leaked DSML tool-call tags, then rewrites the resulting empty turn into a retryable error so the host's built-in retry re-issues the request; prose that merely contains tags passes through untouched.
description.zh: 丢弃只含泄漏 DSML 工具调用标签的整段文本；若整轮没有产生任何可见内容，把结尾改写成可重试错误，交给宿主内置重试重新请求；正文夹带标签的输出原样放行。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: workspace Markdown notes with provenance, review status, BM25 search, and four km_* tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库：工作区 Markdown 笔记，带来源、审核状态、BM25 检索与 4 个 km_* 工具。

description.en: Registers 36 bundled agent skills (research writing, LaTeX, experiments, design review, office documents, animation, Windows shell and dsh plugin conventions) as one host-only skill provider with no UI, no network calls and no telemetry of its own; skill scripts run with the user's permissions only when invoked, local skills of the same name take priority, and uninstall removes all 36.
description.zh: 把 36 个内置 agent 技能（科研写作、LaTeX、实验、设计评审、办公文档、动画、Windows shell 与 dsh 插件规范）注册为一个纯宿主侧的技能提供者：没有界面、没有网络请求，也没有自己的遥测；技能脚本以用户的权限运行。

description.en: Homework helper for the AI Passport device: turns homework screenshots into a checklist with per-task countdown timers and push-to-talk, plus a parent dashboard. It runs its own HTTP server on 0.0.0.0:8787 by default so the device on the same Wi-Fi can reach it: the parent dashboard only accepts connections from this computer, and a device needs a token issued after you approve its pairing code.
description.zh: AI Passport 作业助手：把作业截图整理成清单，设备上逐项倒计时、按住说话，并提供家长后台。默认会在 0.0.0.0:8787 上开自己的 HTTP 服务，让同一 Wi-Fi 下的设备能连：家长后台只接受本机连接，设备要在你批准配对码后拿到令牌才能访问。

description.en: Adds read-only Git status colors, file badges and directory change summaries to the native DSH file tree, with cached status reads and a manual refresh button.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生文件树中显示只读 Git 状态颜色、文件标记和目录变更汇总，提供状态缓存及手动刷新按钮。

description.en: macOS only. Shows a live badge in DSH and an optional SwiftBar menu-bar item reporting what the Yunshu (Eagleyun SASE) endpoint agent is doing on this Mac right now — TCC permission requests, its own agent logs (screen capture, clipboard, browser URL reads, browser window counts), DLP scan paths and the process table. Read-only: it never blocks, disables or modifies the agent, keeps the last 60 events in memory only, writes three state files locally and makes no network calls. Requires the Yunshu agent to be installed; SwiftBar is optional.
description.zh: 仅 macOS。在 DSH 顶栏和可选的 SwiftBar 菜单栏显示云枢（Yunshu / 鹰云 SASE）终端 agent 此刻在本机做什么：TCC 权限申请、云枢自身日志（截屏、剪贴板读写、读取前台浏览器地址、各浏览器窗口数）、DLP 扫描的文件路径、进程表。纯只读——不拦截、不禁用、不修改云枢，只在内存保留最近 60 条动作，本地写三个状态文件，不联网。需要本机已安装云枢；SwiftBar 可选，不装也能用。

description.en: Cross-session memory and compaction archives for dsh, plus a persona kernel. After each substantive turn a background model call extracts facts, preferences, open tasks and commitments; entries carry ids, fade when they stop being mentioned, are capped per kind and can be corrected. When the host compacts a conversation the compressed span is written to the note vault as an archive card whose catalog is injected into the session, so details can be read back by id. Ships an append-only ledger, a settings page, a /whale command group and nine tools.
description.zh: dsh 的跨会话记忆与压缩档案插件，另带人格内核。每轮有实质内容时由一次后台模型调用萃出事实、偏好、未完成的事与答应过的事；条目带编号，久不提会淡化，按类限额，也可以纠正。宿主动压缩时，被压掉的一段落成档案卡写进笔记库，目录注入会话，需要细节时按编号读回原文。另有只追加台账、设置页、/whale 命令组与九个工具。

description.en: A full-viewport donkey-mill background for the DSH Web UI: an animated top-down donkey or a Chinese-character form circles the millstone, accelerating with the model's live token throughput and plodding slowly when idle; a bottom-right panel switches form, adjusts opacity and hides the scene, persisting in localStorage.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的全屏驴拉磨背景：俯视动画驴或汉字形态绕磨盘转动，转速随模型实时 token 吞吐加快、空闲时缓慢踱步；右下角面板可切换形态、调节透明度、隐藏背景，设置保存在 localStorage。

description.en: Windows session-end reminder for DeepSeek Harness: an in-window unread badge that lists session names and jumps to the session when clicked, two Web Audio chimes, taskbar flashing, and a tray badge on the whale icon; only visible sessions are counted, and the settings page has seven options including a zh/en switch.
description.zh: Windows 会话结束提醒：窗口内未读浮层列出会话名、点击即跳转到该会话，两段 Web Audio 提示音，任务栏闪烁，并在托盘鲸鱼图标上叠加数字徽章；只统计可见会话，设置页含中英文切换等七项。

description.en: Keep your git workflow inside DeepSeek Harness. A composer chip shows the current branch at a glance; the TRAE-style popup lets you switch or create branches, fetch remotes, commit & push a subset of changes, merge with a clear source -> target flow, and stash / restore partial changes — all without leaving the chat. Popovers dock above the composer so your draft stays visible; the change list is prefetched when the menu opens; and the plugin confirms before touching a dirty tree.
description.zh: 让 git 操作不离开 DSH 聊天窗口。输入框工具行的胶囊实时显示当前分支；TRAE 风格弹层一键切换/新建分支、同步远端、勾选改动提交推送、按来源 -> 目标流向合并分支、暂存与恢复部分改动。所有面板停靠在输入框上方，不遮挡草稿；菜单打开时预取改动列表；工作区不干净时先确认再操作。非 git 目录自动隐藏。

description.en: Adds sidebar collapse, a 248px compact mode, and panel-list folding to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏加上收起/展开、248px 紧凑模式与面板列表折叠。

description.en: Lightweight cross-session reflection: at the end of each turn it writes 3-5 reusable facts (tool chain, file paths, config items, pitfalls) as a card in .dsh/reflections/{date}.md, and on a new session it injects the last 3 cards at the end of the system prompt. Extraction uses the real ctx.llm.stream; when no model route is available it falls back to a heuristic built only from the session log and labels the source honestly on the card. No timers, no quarantine, no approval flow; cards are plain Markdown you can edit or delete.
description.zh: 轻量级跨会话反思：每轮结束时把 3–5 条可复用事实（工具链、文件路径、配置项、踩过的坑）写成 .dsh/reflections/{日期}.md 卡片，新会话启动时自动把最近 3 张卡片注入系统提示词末尾。提炼走真实的 ctx.llm.stream，模型不可用时降级为只读会话日志的启发式提取，并在卡片上如实标注来源。没有定时器、隔离区和审批流；卡片是普通 Markdown，可直接编辑删除。

description.en: Native token usage for the dsh-go phone app: status strip, panel, per-turn notes and an exported card. Counted locally, no network.
description.zh: 给 dsh-go 手机 App 加原生 Token 用量显示，状态条、面板、回复脚注和用量卡片全都有，数据本地统计不联网。
